mapper.select: select category_seq, parent_seq, name from tbl_category where category_seq = #{categorySeq} and enabled = 'Y'
select m.name from tbl_member m join tbl_expert_profile p on p.expert_seq = m.member_seq where m.member_seq = #{expertSeq} and m.role = 'ROLE_EXPERT' and m.enabled = 'Y' and p.hidden = 'N'

select distinct c.category_seq, c.parent_seq, c.name, c.sort_order from tbl_talent t join tbl_category c on c.category_seq = t.category_seq where t.expert_seq = #{expertSeq} and t.enabled = 'Y' and c.enabled = 'Y' and c.parent_seq is not null order by c.sort_order, c.category_seq

select q.question_seq, q.category_seq, q.content, q.question_type, q.required, q.sort_order, o.option_seq, o.content as option_content, o.sort_order as option_sort_order from tbl_question q left join tbl_question_option o on o.question_seq = q.question_seq and o.enabled = 'Y' where q.category_seq = #{categorySeq} and q.enabled = 'Y' order by q.sort_order, q.question_seq, o.sort_order, o.option_seq
select address from tbl_member where member_seq = #{memberSeq}
mapper.insert:
select seq_request.nextval from dual
insert into tbl_request (request_seq, customer_seq, expert_seq, category_seq, address, wish_date, budget, content, status, quote_deadline) values (#{requestSeq}, #{customerSeq}, #{expertSeq}, #{categorySeq}, #{address}, to_date(#{wishDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{budget}, #{content}, 'OPEN', sysdate + 2)
insert into tbl_request_answer (answer_seq, request_seq, question_seq, option_seq, answer) values (seq_request_answer.nextval, #{requestSeq}, #{questionSeq}, #{optionSeq}, #{answer})
insert into tbl_request_file (file_seq, request_seq, org_filename, save_filename) values (seq_request_file.nextval, #{requestSeq}, #{orgFilename}, #{saveFilename})
mapper.select: select r.request_seq, r.customer_seq, r.expert_seq, r.category_seq, c.name as category_name, m.name as expert_name, r.address, to_char(r.wish_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as wish_date, r.budget, r.content, r.status, r.hidden, r.quote_count, to_char(r.quote_deadline, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as quote_deadline, to_char(r.select_deadline, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as select_deadline, to_char(r.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate, case r.status when 'OPEN' then floor((r.quote_deadline - sysdate) * 24 * 60) when 'CLOSED' then floor((r.select_deadline - sysdate) * 24 * 60) end as remain_minutes from tbl_request r join tbl_category c on c.category_seq = r.category_seq left join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = r.expert_seq where r.request_seq = #{requestSeq} and r.customer_seq = #{customerSeq}

select q.question_seq, q.content as question, nvl(o.content, a.answer) as answer from tbl_request_answer a join tbl_question q on q.question_seq = a.question_seq left join tbl_question_option o on o.option_seq = a.option_seq where a.request_seq = #{requestSeq} order by q.sort_order, q.question_seq, o.sort_order, a.answer_seq
select file_seq, request_seq, org_filename, save_filename from tbl_request_file where request_seq = #{requestSeq} order by file_seq

select q.quote_seq, q.request_seq, q.expert_seq, m.name as expert_name, q.price, q.work_days, q.content, q.status, to_char(q.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate, nvl(p.hidden, 'N') as expert_hidden from tbl_quote q join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = q.expert_seq left join tbl_expert_profile p on p.expert_seq = q.expert_seq where q.request_seq = #{requestSeq} order by q.quote_seq
mapper.update: update tbl_request set status = 'CLOSED', select_deadline = quote_deadline + 7 where status = 'OPEN' and quote_deadline <= sysdate and quote_count > 0
update tbl_request set status = 'EXPIRED' where status = 'OPEN' and quote_deadline <= sysdate and quote_count = 0
update tbl_quote set status = 'UNSELECTED' where status = 'WAITING' and request_seq in (select request_seq from tbl_request where status = 'CLOSED' and select_deadline <= sysdate)
update tbl_request set status = 'EXPIRED' where status = 'CLOSED' and select_deadline <= sysdate
update tbl_quote set status = 'UNSELECTED' where request_seq = #{requestSeq} and status = 'WAITING'
